yt.title: An AI that was always right... or was it?
notes: Task: tell a husky from a wolf in a photo
It got the answers right on its test
Then researchers asked: what is it looking at?

lines.text: Researchers built an AI that could tell a husky from a wolf. [1] Then they checked what it was actually looking at. [2] It wasn't the animal.

yt.title: It learned a shortcut
notes: Training wolves: almost all in snow
Training huskies: almost all on grass
Shortcut learned: snow means wolf
Husky in snow → predicted WOLF

lines.text: It was looking at the snow. [1] In the training photos, almost every wolf stood in snow... [2] and every husky, on grass. [3] So the AI learned a shortcut: snow means wolf. [4] Show it a husky in the snow... [5] wolf.

yt.title: Garbage in, garbage out
notes: A model only learns patterns its data shows
Biased or messy data → biased, wrong answers
More training can't fix bad data

lines.text: This is the golden rule of AI. [1] Garbage in... [2] garbage out. [3] A model can only learn what its data shows it.

yt.title: Four things good data needs
notes: Quantity: enough examples to learn from
Quality: correct labels, no junk or duplicates
Diversity: every place, person and situation
Freshness: data that matches today's world

lines.text: So what makes data good? [1] Quantity: enough examples. [2] Quality: correct labels, no junk. [3] Diversity: wolves on grass too, and faces of every skin tone. [4] And freshness... so the world hasn't moved on.

yt.title: Train, validation, test
notes: Train set (~80%): the model learns from it
Validation set (~10%): tune settings
Test set (~10%): hidden until the very end
Score on unseen data = real performance

lines.text: And to catch a cheating AI... [1] we hide some data away. [2] Train on most of it. [3] Tune on a little. [4] And test on photos it has never seen. [5] A surprise exam.

data.question: An AI spots cats perfectly... but only indoors. Which rule did its data break?

yt.title: Crack this case
notes: An AI spots cats perfectly... only indoors
Which data rule did it break?
Answer: Diversity

lines.text: Your turn, detective. An AI spots cats perfectly... but only indoors. [1] Which rule did its data break? <pause 2> [2] Diversity! It never saw a cat outdoors.

points: Good data: quantity, quality, diversity, freshness
Always test on data it has never seen

yt.title: An AI is only as smart as its data
notes: Garbage in, garbage out
Check quantity, quality, diversity, freshness
Always test on data it has never seen

lines.text: Case closed. [1] An AI is only as smart as its data. [2] Next: the AI that memorised every answer... and still failed the exam. Follow, so you don't miss it.
